text: - - T (b) 10 points For each of the following statements, decide if the statement is true for false, and briefly (one sentence!) justify your answer. 1. A red-black tree has black height 4. What is the maximum number of nodes possible in the tree? 2. A red-black tree has 45 nodes. What is the smallest possible black height for such a tree? 3. A red-black tree has 45 nodes. What is the largest possible tree height? 4. A red-black tree has 45 nodes. Is it possible that all nodes in the tree are colored black? 5. A red-black tree has 7 nodes and height 2. Is there only one possible coloring for such a tree?
